editorial:
Imagine you are visiting a quiet beach town where everything seems normal until the birds suddenly decide they hate humans. You follow a wealthy socialite who heads to this town to win over a local lawyer, but the romance takes a back seat when crows and gulls start attacking people without warning. The vibe starts off as a light rom-com, but it quickly turns into a nightmare. You will feel the tension build as the birds go from being a weird nuisance to a full-on army taking over the streets and homes.

What really works here is how the movie makes you feel uneasy even when nothing is happening. The acting is solid, and the bird attacks are still scary today, though some of the effects look a bit old. It is a slow burn, but the payoff is worth it. If you want the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see every feather. If you love owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for a rainy day. You should definitely check this out if you like old-school thrills.
endingExplained: The movie ends on a very mysterious note. After a huge battle with the birds inside the house, the main characters realize they cannot fight back. They decide to flee the town in a car, driving away slowly while birds still follow them. There is no big explanation for why the birds attacked or if the war is over. You are left wondering if the rest of the world is also under attack or if they are finally safe.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic thrillers and mysteries.
